answer: Peers cross-validate fingerprints like gardeners weeding a shared garden, rejecting duplicates before they earn reputation. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work staking: each new agent identity must burn measurable compute tied to a unique hardware fingerprint, then stake copper-denominated bonds that vest slower than a glacier, so fake accounts bleed real resources. Attacker cost scales with identity count, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0007's threat model.
